patch_description: This implementation uses a deterministic population-based maximin search in barycentric coordinates rather than returning a degenerate point set. The three triangle vertices are retained as anchors, while the remaining eight points are evolved inside the simplex using differential-style exchange mutations and a final local repair phase focused on the currently worst triangles. Barycentric coordinates guarantee every returned point lies inside the equilateral triangle, and triangle areas are evaluated through barycentric determinants, which are exactly the Euclidean areas normalized by the enclosing triangle area.
